query: textattacks modular design enables researchers to easily construct attacks from combinations of novel and existing components facilitating the exploration of adversarial methods in nlp
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.citation_count,
  p.year
FROM Papers p
WHERE
  (p.title ILIKE '%textattack%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%textattack%')
  OR (
    (p.title ILIKE '%adversarial%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%adversarial%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%nlp%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%nlp%' OR p.title ILIKE '%natural language%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%natural language%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%attack%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%attack%')
  )
ORDER BY
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%textattack%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%textattack%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%adversarial%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%adversarial%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%attack%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%attack%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%nlp%' OR p.title ILIKE '%natural language%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%nlp%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%natural language%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
  ) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

query: our proposed select answer and explain sae system introduces a novel pairwise learning to rank loss to effectively filter out answer unrelated documents significantly reducing distraction during multi hop reading comprehension tasks
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.citation_count,
  p.year
FROM Papers p
WHERE
  (
    to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(p.abstract, ''))
    @@ plainto_tsquery(
      'english',
      'select answer explain sae system "pairwise learning to rank" "learning to rank" "multi hop" "multi-hop" "reading comprehension" "answer selection" "document ranking"'
    )
  )
  OR (
    lower(p.title) LIKE '%learning to rank%'
    OR lower(p.title) LIKE '%pairwise learning to rank%'
    OR lower(p.title) LIKE '%multi hop%'
    OR lower(p.title) LIKE '%multi-hop%'
    OR lower(p.title) LIKE '%reading comprehension%'
    OR lower(p.title) LIKE '%answer selection%'
  )
ORDER BY
  ts_rank_cd(
    to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(p.abstract, '')),
    plainto_tsquery(
      'english',
      'select answer explain sae system "pairwise learning to rank" "learning to rank" "multi hop" "multi-hop" "reading comprehension" "answer selection" "document ranking"'
    )
  ) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100

query: experimental results on two multi label image databases illustrate that our approach enhances both the efficiency and accuracy of multi label image retrieval compared to traditional batch based methods, by introducing projection functions that learn online from streaming data our method transforms the inefficient updating process into an efficient one by projecting binary codes into a different binary space
sql:
SELECT
  corpus_id,
  title,
  abstract,
  venue,
  canonical_venue,
  year,
  citation_count
FROM Papers
WHERE
  (
    title ILIKE '%multi label image%'
    OR title ILIKE '%multi-label image%'
    OR title ILIKE '%multi label retrieval%'
    OR title ILIKE '%multi-label retrieval%'
    OR title ILIKE '%binary code%'
    OR title ILIKE '%hashing%'
    OR title ILIKE '%online learning%'
    OR title ILIKE '%streaming data%'
  )
  OR (
    abstract IS NOT NULL AND (
      abstract ILIKE '%multi label image%'
      OR abstract ILIKE '%multi-label image%'
      OR abstract ILIKE '%multi label retrieval%'
      OR abstract ILIKE '%multi-label retrieval%'
      OR abstract ILIKE '%binary code%'
      OR abstract ILIKE '%hashing%'
      OR abstract ILIKE '%online learning%'
      OR abstract ILIKE '%streaming data%'
      OR abstract ILIKE '%projection function%'
      OR abstract ILIKE '%online hashing%'
      OR abstract ILIKE '%efficient updating%'
    )
  )
ORDER BY
  ts_rank_cd(
    setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(title, '')), 'A') ||
    setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(abstract, '')), 'B'),

      'multi & label & image & retrieval & binary & code & hashing & online & streaming'
    )
  ) DESC,
  citation_count DESC NULLS LAST,

SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.citation_count,
  p.year
FROM Papers p

    OR
    (p.abstract ILIKE '%word embedding%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%word-embedding%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%embeddings%')

  AND

    p.title ILIKE '%similarity%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%similarity%'

     ELSE 0

query: our methodology challenges the reliance on costly expert created resources by leveraging readily available linguistic data making morphological analysis accessible for a wider range of languages, we propose a discriminative string transduction approach which exploits plain inflection tables and raw text corpora thus obviating the need for expert annotation
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
WHERE
  (
    to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(p.abstract, ''))
    @@ plainto_tsquery('english',
      'morphological & analysis & morphology & inflection & inflectional & "string transduction" & discriminative & corpus & corpora & "raw text" & "expert annotation" & "expert-created resources" & "linguistic data"')
  )
  OR (
    (p.title ILIKE '%morpholog%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%morpholog%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%inflect%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%inflect%')
  )

  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p

    to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(p.abstract, ''))
    @@ plainto_tsquery('english',
      'decision list learner treebank classification "word pair" dependency link suffix character parsing accuracy')
  )
  OR (
    lower(p.title) LIKE '%decision list%'
    OR lower(p.title) LIKE '%treebank%'
    OR lower(p.title) LIKE '%dependency parsing%'
    OR lower(p.abstract) LIKE '%decision list%'
    OR lower(p.abstract) LIKE '%treebank%'
    OR lower(p.abstract) LIKE '%dependency parsing%'
  )
ORDER BY
  ts_rank_cd(
    to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(p.abstract, '')),
    plainto_tsquery('english',
      'decision list learner treebank classification "word pair" dependency link suffix character parsing accuracy')
  ) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

  plainto_tsquery('english',
    'bayesian classifier combination bcc "classifier combination" "ensemble" "named entity recognition" ner "minimally supervised" "weak supervision"')
ORDER BY relevance DESC
LIMIT 100

query: our results show that maop significantly outperforms previous methods in terms of sample efficiency and generalization over novel environments for learning environment models
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
WHERE
  (p.title ILIKE '%maop%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%maop%')
  OR (
    (p.title ILIKE '%model-based%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%model-based%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%reinforcement%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%reinforcement%')
  )
  OR (
    (p.title ILIKE '%sample efficiency%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%sample efficiency%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%generalization%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%generalization%')
  )
  OR (
    (p.title ILIKE '%environment model%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%environment model%')
    OR (p.title ILIKE '%world model%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%world model%')
  )
ORDER BY
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%maop%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%maop%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN (p.title ILIKE '%sample efficiency%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%sample efficiency%') THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN (p.title ILIKE '%generalization%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%generalization%') THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN (p.title ILIKE '%environment model%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%environment model%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN (p.title ILIKE '%world model%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%world model%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN (p.title ILIKE '%reinforcement%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%reinforcement%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
  ) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC,
  p.year DESC
LIMIT 100

query: svcsts outperformed all other participating systems in interpretable sts for non chunked sentence input highlighting its effectiveness in handling semantic similarity across multiple languages
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
WHERE
  (p.title ILIKE '%svcsts%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%svcsts%')
  OR (
    (p.title ILIKE '%semantic textual similarity%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%semantic textual similarity%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%interpretable%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%interpretable%')
  )
  OR (
    (p.title ILIKE '%sts%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%sts%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%interpretable%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%interpretable%')
  )
  OR (
    (p.title ILIKE '%semantic similarity%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%semantic similarity%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%multilingual%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%multilingual%' OR
         p.title ILIKE '%multiple languages%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%multiple languages%')
  )
ORDER BY
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%svcsts%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%svcsts%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%interpretable%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%interpretable%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%semantic textual similarity%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%semantic textual similarity%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%semantic similarity%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%semantic similarity%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%multilingual%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%multilingual%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%sts%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%sts%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
  ) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC NULLS LAST,
  p.year DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100
